title: How did you negotiate your first offer?
content: I just got an offer from a data analytics company and the base is lower than I expected. Did anyone negotiate successfully as a new grad? What did you say?

title: Coming back from maternity leave - tips?
content: My 16-week leave ends next month. I'm nervous about catching up and pumping at work. How did your team support your return to work?

title: Is a fertility benefit worth a lower salary?
content: One offer has a big fertility benefit and childcare stipend, the other pays about 12% more but has basic benefits. How do you compare total value?

title: Only woman on my engineering team
content: I'm the only woman on a team of nine. Everyone is nice, but I get interrupted in meetings a lot. Has anyone found a good way to handle this with a manager?

title: Remote companies with good parental leave?
content: Looking for fully remote employers that offer at least 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Please share any you know of.

title: Asking for a promotion after 2 years
content: I have exceeded my goals two cycles in a row but was told to wait another year for a promotion. Is that normal? How did you build your case?

title: Reporting harassment - what actually happened?
content: For people who used their company's harassment reporting hotline: did HR take it seriously, and was the process confidential?

title: Salary bands in cloud security
content: Kestrel-style companies publish pay bands for engineering. What base salary range is fair for a mid-level security engineer in Denver?

title: Work-life balance on shift schedules
content: Working in food manufacturing with rotating shifts and a toddler. Does anyone have a shift-swap arrangement that actually works?

title: Changing careers into UX design at 35
content: Thinking of an online bootcamp to switch from teaching to UX design. Did anyone make this switch? How long until your first job?

title: Found out a male colleague with the same title earns 18% more
content: We compared offers over coffee and the gap is real. Same level, same start date. Has anyone raised this with HR and gotten an adjustment? How did you bring it up?

title: Does posting salary ranges actually close the pay gap?
content: My state now requires ranges in job ads. The ranges at my company are huge ($90k-$160k). Curious whether anyone has seen it change offers for women in practice.

title: How much paid maternity leave did your company really give?
content: The handbook says 16 weeks but my manager is hinting I should come back after 10. Is that normal? What did you actually take?

title: Telling my manager I'm pregnant - when did you do it?
content: I'm 14 weeks and have a performance review coming up. Should I tell them before or after the review? Worried it will affect my rating.

title: Moving from engineer to engineering manager at 29
content: I was offered a team lead role. I love coding but I also want to grow. For those who made the switch, what do you wish you had known in your first year?

title: Is a 5-year plan still a thing? How do you set career goals?
content: Every mentor asks where I see myself in five years and I honestly don't know. How do you set goals when the industry changes this fast?

title: Asked for a raise and was told 'next cycle' - again
content: This is the third time. I have written feedback saying I exceed expectations. Is it time to look elsewhere, or is there another way to push?

title: Pumping rooms: what does your office actually have?
content: Ours is a converted storage closet with no lock. Looking for examples of good lactation rooms to show facilities what to ask for.

title: Going back to school for a master's at 34 - worth it?
content: I'm a product analyst thinking about a part-time MBA or a data science master's. Did the degree change your career trajectory or salary?

title: Managers who made a real difference - what did they do?
content: Collecting examples of things good managers did for you. Mine blocked meetings during school pickup without me having to ask.

title: Reported harassment and now I'm left out of meetings
content: HR closed the case as 'resolved' but my manager stopped inviting me to planning meetings. Is this retaliation? What are my options?

title: Four-day week pilots - has your company tried one?
content: Ours starts in January. Wondering how it went elsewhere, especially for parents and people with caregiving duties.

title: First job offer: how do I know if the salary is fair?
content: Graduating in December. The offer is $72k for a junior UX role in Chicago. I can't tell if that's good. Where do you look for real numbers?

title: Remote work made it easier to get promoted - anyone else?
content: Since going fully remote my work is judged on output, not who is in the room. I got promoted twice in two years. Curious if others had the opposite experience.

title: Childcare stipends - how much is yours?
content: Mine is $250/month, which barely covers a week. Trying to gather data before our benefits survey closes.
